description: List live Discond offers, filtered by merchant, branch, provider, category, validity or online-only, sorted by newest, expiring or biggest discount. Has no place filter: filter by merchant id instead. Requires the user to be signed in to Discond.

business_branch_id.description: Only offers valid at this branch of the merchant.

business_id.description: Only offers of this merchant (id from discond_find_discounts).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response meta.next_cursor

include_all_branches.description: With business_branch_id: also include offers valid at all of the merchant's branches.

q.description: Words in the offer or merchant name.

sort.description: discount: biggest first (default). newest: most recently added. expiring: ending soonest.

name: discond_list_offers
title: List offers
